title: Game layout -- how does one make a point and click interface in RPG Maker MV ?

posts.author: The_Humbugg
posts.body:
Hello all,
I'm currently working on a game that I'd like to lay out much in the same way that Nankidais
Your Turn To Die
is laid out and playable. For the context, this the game I'm speaking about:
My question for today is how I can achieve what Nankidai was able to do in having an image display while being fully interactable? I've been able to replicate it to some extent with the use of parallax maps and Orange's hitbox extension plugin to place hitbox events on said map the player can 'click' on [not really - I don't have the picture common plugin so I made the player invisible and upped their speed, haha] to trigger said events.
However, I'm fully aware such an approach has its limitations - for one, the map is prone to loop itself. As such, I wanted to know how I could achieve this in a way that allowed me to more or less build a point and click interface for my game without having to game the engine or messily come up with an idea.

posts.body:
another is a mouse plugin with event's to "click" on which can be easier,
like I do have one that has events respond to "click" but not updated yet.
yanfly has one I believe as well for DK that can set one.
while there are multiple mouse plugins, search for them and set events
otherwise, go with Aqua ButtonCallCommon (which I don't know how it works).
